t.zh: 一句话里留一个自由的 x，就成了<wiki-ref to="query"></wiki-ref>：世界里哪些东西代入 x 能让这句话成立，哪些就是答案。数据库的查询语言 SQL，核心就是这样的一阶逻辑。
t.en: A sentence with one x left free is a <wiki-ref to="query"></wiki-ref>: the things of a world that make it true when put in for x are the answer. At its core, SQL, the language of databases, is first-order logic like this.

t.zh: 这里有两家人。同一句查询要在两家里都选对，靠记名字不行。
t.en: There are two families here. One query must be right in both, so remembering names will not do.

say.en: x is a child of Ann.

brief.zh: 拼一句带着 x 的话，在每一家里，让它正好选中安的孩子。
brief.en: Build a sentence with x in it that picks out exactly Ann’s children in each family.
